address: 210 Hollywood Road, Sheung Wan, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Owner-chef Vicky Lau tells edible stories with tasting menus that mingle French and Chinese influences. There is no shortage of flair, especially in the longer Jade menu where each dish is an ode to an ingredient, such as scallop complemented by uni and caviar velouté. The intimate, feminine interior, adorned in neutrals, gold and muted pinks, provides the perfect foil to what is also a visual treat, courtesy of delicate, beautiful plating....
